t: Toupret Powder Wood Filler is a high-performance solution for wood repair and shaping tasks. This quick-drying powder filler is suitable for all types of wood, including exotic species, chipboard, and plywood, making it ideal for joiners and carpenters. It offers excellent adhesion and has no depth limit, allowing for extensive repairs on interior and exterior wood. The filler is easy to sand, can be drilled and screwed, and is ready to be stained or painted with any conventional paint, varnish, or stain after just three hours, ensuring efficient project completion.
b: Ready to Paint & Stain in 3 Hours
Can be Drilled & Screwed Once Cured
For Use on All Wood Types
